The copy constructor is already minimal and compiles to optimal code, so no change is needed. Returning the identical function preserves behavior and performance.

```cpp
Field::Field(const Field &field)
    : FieldBase(field)
    , profile(field.profile)
    , profileIndex(field.profileIndex)
    , type(field.type)
    , isFieldExpanded(field.isFieldExpanded)
{
}
```
